alternatives_rejected.why: frontend_latency-90 deviation (z=82.1) is far smaller than recommendationservice_latency-90 (z=3175.22) in E1, and E2 shows inbound calls to recommendationservice slowing 11.15x, so frontend is waiting on recommendationservice rather than causing the slowdown.

E1 shows a large memory deviation (z=114.84, +574.2%), which a pure network delay would not produce. Own-span self-time rose only 2.94x (E2) while inbound latency rose 11.15x, which fits resource exhaustion slowing request handling more than a fixed injected delay. This is the closest alternative and was not fully ruled out.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll the recommendationservice pods to reclaim memory and confirm latency recovers. Then check memory limits and requests, and look for a leak or unbounded cache in the ListRecommendations path (E3 shows high request volume on it). Raise the memory limit if needed.
